name: URTC-SMART-RACK
build: bash build_firmware.sh. Real host-native unit tests run before the arm-none-eabi-gcc cross-compile.
notes: Hardware-independent pure-C logic: tool-ID decoding, usage and maintenance tracking, the Smart Idle pre-heat target with a safe-state target, a versioned rack command protocol (framing with CRC8, actuation-limit validation, a link watchdog), a multi-slot inventory with per-tool limits, and the layer that holds every slot in the safe state while the link is lost. It is tested on a PC and run against a virtual rack with injected faults (compared with the Python model of the rack). It has never been run on a board. A host-side scenario harness plays valid, corrupted, out-of-range, timed-out and duplicate frames through the whole pipeline, and the ARM cross-compile is verified with a size report. Real CAN/F-RAM/GPIO I/O needs a real PCB, which does not exist yet.
